critical_params.superradiant_eta_crit_basis: Exact thermodynamic Dicke-model critical coupling at resonance (omega_q = omega_c): eta_c = sqrt(omega_q/omega_c)/2 = 0.5 (Gilmore 1976; see manuscript main text and SI). The historical value 0.15 stored in this field was a metadata error (it coincides with the DCE operating point eta=0.150, not a critical coupling) and is corrected here.
